## Landed: Gerrit change 1628 (merged)

Scope was rewritten before implementation because the originally-filed mechanism is DISPROVEN
(evidence in the earlier comment): `branch -f` force-moves the ref onto whatever HEAD names, so
the bundle's `HEAD` and `refs/heads/<ref>` always agree and the literal `HEAD` argument is not
the fault. The real defect is that the fold merges into the tracker's WORKTREE HEAD, so a
checked-out side branch's commits get merged into the ticket history and published.

Per the operator decision, this ticket closed the silent-corruption door only: the heal now
REFUSES when the tracker is not on the published ref, before any bundle is downloaded or
merged, raising the module's existing `S3DoctorConflict` — the established loud channel, which
the sole caller in `_store/push.py` already logs with its hint and escalates under `strict`.
Detached HEAD is refused by the same guard. The guard runs after the single-bundle check, so a
no-op store is unaffected.

This also made the `git branch -f` fallback in `_publish_and_prune` unreachable, so it was
removed — force-moving the ref onto an unrelated branch's merge was the mechanism that
published the wrong history.

### Verification

RED first: the three refusal tests failed with `DID NOT RAISE S3DoctorConflict` before the
guard, while the no-op test passed throughout (proving the guard did not change benign
behaviour). After: the refusal raises, the remote bundle set is byte-identical to what it was
found as, the side branch's commit is NOT reachable from the published ref, and no bundle is
ever fetched (asserted with a download spy). A tracker correctly on the ref still heals
losslessly — the pre-existing lossless-heal tests are untouched and green.

On the landed tree: 27 s3_doctor/doctor tests pass, `make lint` and `make typecheck` green;
`Verified +1` and `LLM-Review +1`.

### Follow-up

Teaching the fold to target `refs/heads/<ref>` (needs `merge-tree`/`commit-tree` or a scratch
worktree, since `git merge` only merges into the checked-out branch) is filed as
`envious-metal-budgie` (bcfb-0d18-20fc-46b9), linked `discovered_from` this ticket. That work
retires this guard.

### Closing class: preexisting

The defect shipped with the module and was never a regression; it is latent for rebar's own
stores, which always have the published ref checked out.
